Highlights:
High-speed Gen4 performance for gamers is here. Introducing the Crucial® P310 2280 Gen4 NVMe™ SSD, a leader in the Gen4 space with sequential reads/writes1 up to 7,100/6,000MB/s. Engineered with the latest Micron® 3D NAND technology, the Crucial P310 comes in generous capacities² and offers flexible backward compatibility, performing 2x faster than Gen3 SSDs3 and offering 20% faster performance in real-world tasks6 compared to other Gen4 SSDs when booting Windows, starting applications such as Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, and working with popular applications such as Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. The P310 is the NVMe storage solution that gives gamers the edge they crave.

## NVMe ™ M.2 SSD

Sequential reads/ writes up to 7,100/6,000MB/s1

Micron® Advanced 3D NAND and innovative controller technology

Limited warranty PS5 TM compatible

Shift up to Gen4 Speed 
Built with Micron ® Advanced 3D NAND, P310 Gen4 SSDs offer blazing fast sequential reads up to 7,100MB/s¹ — 2x 
faster³ than Gen3 NVMe SSDs and 20x faster than SATA. Speed up your bootups, file transfers, and game loads without 
compromising on quality. 
All work or more play? 
Don’t let dull performance slow you down. With up to 2TB of storage and 20% better performance than other Gen4 SSDs, 
you can do it all faster, including gaming, booting Windows, running apps like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, or Microsoft 
Excel and Powerpoint⁶. 
Buy smarter 
Instead of buying a new laptop, upgrade with the dependable P310 NVMe SSD and level up your strategy and laptop 
lifecycle. This easy-to-install SSD offers secure, efficient space for all your Gen4 laptop and desktop files, along with Gen3 
backward compatibility. SSDs with heatsinks are not compatible with laptops. Please choose the P310 without heatsink for 
your laptop upgrade.

Reading the figures

- — not published by the vendor. Distinct from "not yet entered", which fails the build.
- ≈14,000 the source states an approximate value.
- 14,000 the vendor's series-level figure (usually "Up to"), not measured at this capacity.
- The three "review" columns come from one review that ran a full-drive write test or photographed the bare board; only the capacity it tested has a value, and the source is on the model page. Post-cache write is the speed right after the SLC cache runs out; some drives slow down further later, as the model notes say.

## Notes

- 2230 于 2024-07-17 发布，2280（500GB–2TB）于 2024-09-17 发布；散热片版在 2025-01-07 的 CES 新闻稿里宣布当月上市；4TB 首次出现在 2025 年版 2280 flyer。
- 2025 年版 2280 flyer 的 4TB 两行部件号印成与 2TB 相同的 CT2000P310SSD8 / CT2000P310SSD5，所以 4TB 部件号留空。
- 随机读写各版厂商资料不一：2024 年版 2280 flyer 与 2230 flyer 写 1TB 随机读写「1M K IOPS」/「1M K IOPS」、2TB「1.2M K IOPS」/「1.2M K IOPS」；2025 年版 2280 flyer 改为 1TB、2TB、4TB 都是随机读 1M、随机写 1.2M，2280 发布稿也写「Random reads up to 1 million … random writes up to 1.2 million IOPS」。2230 没有更新版资料，表里照 2024 年版。
- 散热片版 CT1000P310SSD5 / CT2000P310SSD5 在 flyer 里与同容量裸盘规格相同，表里只列裸盘部件号；500GB 与 2230 没有散热片版。
- 2230 与 2280 的 2TB 用同一个 NAND 封装（Tom's Hardware 拆机：sixteen 232-Layer QLC flash dies in a single package），两种形态都是单面。
- 4TB 没有拆机资料，颗粒是否与其余容量相同不明。
- 停产依据：Micron 2025-12-03 宣布退出 Crucial 消费级业务。
